status: Exploratory failure-attribution extension frozen after E0 all-model results and E1 Bolt/Small results, before E2 outputs. Not confirmatory.
cohort: Exactly all 14592 E0 test cases per model. No new model inference or test exclusions.
question: Does failure originate from unseen outage structure, unseen domain, or noisy historical winner selection?
fit: Same HistGradientBoostingRegressor and all hyperparameters as E0. No tuning. Labels are stored E0 losses from development origins only.

regimes.original: Source domains; dev; clean/random/middle; rates <=0.25. Refit all three E0 gates and require identical test choices.
regimes.source_tail: Source domains; dev; all families; rates <=0.25. Full, rate-only, width-only gates.
regimes.source_all: Source domains; dev; all families; all rates. Full-feature gate.
regimes.target_tail: Held-out domain's dev origins; all families; rates <=0.25. Full gate. This explicitly uses target-domain calibration and is NOT domain-transfer evaluation.

replay: Matched historical replay restricted to native vs seasonal median, with either plain mean-difference selection or mean > one estimated standard error from the 3 recorded historical windows. This is a heuristic, not a safety/coverage guarantee.
analysis: Preserve every regime. Same fixed-domain 10000 paired circular block bootstrap, block length4 and shared ETTh1/ETTh2 draws. Previously inspected test cohort; descriptive intervals only, no adjusted significance claims.
